equipment_type: Air conditioner BACnet gateway (1 indoor unit)
applies_to: Hitachi commercial and VRF indoor units, connected through the wired remote-controller (A/B) bus.
summary: A one-unit Intesis interface that sits on a Hitachi indoor unit's remote-controller bus and serves it as a BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP device. It exposes 31 fixed objects (on/off, mode, setpoint, fan, louvre, room temperature, errors, filter, occupancy logic and remote-controller lock). Several indoor units on the same remote-controller bus can be connected but they are all driven as one group.
notes: The member-object table lists ErrorReset as BI 5 but its object section is a Binary Output; it is listed here as BO 5.
The capacity table says 33 objects; the member table lists 31 plus the Device object.
Units shown as °C follow the °C/°F DIP switch.
ErrorCodeM state texts are the Hitachi error codes listed in the manual's error-code chapter.
UserSetPoint_status and VirtualTempActive report the virtual-temperature function driven by RoomTemperature_command.

source.title: Intesis BACnet IP/MSTP - Hitachi VRF User Manual (INBACHIT001R000)

integration.summary: Connect the gateway to the indoor unit (two-wire A/B remote-controller bus, gateway port RC2, up to 500 m), set the BACnet network on its DIP switches, then write the _command objects (on/off, mode, setpoint, fan) and read back the matching _status objects. One gateway serves one indoor unit (or one remote-controller group), so give each gateway its own MAC address and device instance.

minimum_points.name: SetPoint_status
minimum_points.why: Setpoint the unit is really using

integration.enable: No enable point or BMS/local switch is documented; the gateway accepts BACnet commands as soon as it is communicating with the unit. A wired remote controller can still be used in parallel; BV 2 LockRemoteControl locks it.
integration.remote_sensors: Write a BMS room temperature to AO 1 RoomTemperature_command. BI 14 VirtualTempActive shows whether the gateway is using it, and AI 17 UserSetPoint_status shows the user setpoint written from BACnet while it is active (AI 0 then shows the setpoint actually applied).
setup: BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP is chosen with a DIP switch (MS/TP is the default); switch changes need a power cycle.
BACnet IP: factory static IP 192.168.100.246; change it (or select DHCP) with the Intesis configuration tool.
MS/TP MAC address 0-127 is set on DIP switches; baud rate is DIP-selectable (9600-115200) with autobaud as the default.

Default device instance 246000. In automatic mode the instance is a base (246000, changeable in the configuration tool) + the SW2 MAC address; it can also be set manually or by writing Object_Identifier.
SW4 sets the gateway as slave (default) or master on the Hitachi A/B bus.
The gateway is normally powered from the AC unit; a mini-USB port can power it for bench testing.
gotchas: Every function has a separate _command (AO/BO/MO, commandable) and _status (AI/BI/MI) object; write the command, read the status.
Temperatures follow the Celsius/Fahrenheit DIP switch; the BACnet Units property changes with it.

The Occupancy MV and its four AVs drive built-in logic that sets mode, setpoint and on/off; leave Occupancy at 3 (Disabled) unless you use it, and any manual on/off, mode or setpoint change cancels it.
Several indoor units on one A/B bus are commanded together; individual commands to them are not possible.
